description: Fonts on a page, which #606 found fall back without a trace when they go missing. The top line is Manrope at weight 800, from a file the project carries (assets/, its name percent-escaped in the url); the bottom line is Playfair Display italic, one of the faces scorsese ships, named by family. Static, so one frame. A top line in a thin sans means the project's font did not load; a bottom line in an upright serif or a sans means the browser did not get the shipped faces, or fell back to the host's.
